artworks.title: A Wooded Landscape with a Shepherd and His Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with later(?) touches of green watercolor on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: The image is shot from a slightly elevated point of view, showing various details in the surroundings. The horizon and sky with a few soft clouds are visible in the background. The style appears to be a pen drawing with fine line work creating texture on trees and the landscape. The color palette consists of shades of brown, giving the image an antique look. Two slender trees are visible in the foreground, with figures and animals in the middle ground. In the distance, the landscape rises and falls, with mountains blending into the horizon.

artworks.title: Young Man in a Soft Cap
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall: 29 × 20.5 cm (11 7/16 × 8 1/16 in.), sheet cut irregularly
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, turned to the right. The person has their head slightly tilted forward, with their gaze directed downward. Their facial features are delicately sketched, showing a calm expression. Their hair is partially visible under a wrapped headscarf or turban. The person is wearing a flowing garment with soft, layered lines and a sash around the waist. The sketch is monochromatic, drawn on textured paper. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Standing Figure Wearing a Hat
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person depicted in a full-body sketch standing with a slight tilt, leaning slightly to the right. The face is obscured by a wide-brimmed hat. The individual is wearing formal attire, including a coat draped over the shoulders with intricate button details. The legs are covered with fitted trousers and shoes. The background is plain, focusing the viewer's attention on the figure.

artworks.title: Christ Preaching and Healing (Fragment from the Hundred Guilder Print)
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and William Baillie
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing amid a crowd of people. The scene shows a tall figure at the center of a gathering. The figure stands in an elevated position, with one hand raised and the other open. Around this central figure are a number of individuals with varied postures and expressions. A luminous aura radiates from the central figure, contrasting with the shaded environment. The details in the clothing, facial expressions, and body language of the surrounding figures are depicted with intricate lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Pharisees Debating (Fragment from the Hundred Guilder Print)
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and William Baillie
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people sitting closely together on a bench or similar surface. Each person faces slightly towards another, suggesting interaction. The individuals have detailed facial features, with one man having a long beard and another wearing a hat with a brim. Their clothing includes robes or coats, along with headgear like turbans and hats. The background features a pattern of cross-hatched lines. The overall scene is monochromatic and resembles an etched drawing.

artworks.title: The Man with a Cane (Fragment from the Hundred Guilder Print)
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and William Baillie
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five individuals standing closely together. The central figure is seen from the back, wearing a large hat and a long coat, holding a walking stick. Two individuals on the left wear head coverings, with distinct facial features. To the right, another person is seen in profile wearing a headscarf. In the lower right corner, a crouching figure interacts with a dog. The background features abstract architectural lines.

artworks.title: New York from Heights near Brooklyn
artworks.artist: John Hill, after William Guy Wall
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jo Ann and Julian Ganz
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a cityscape in the background. The painting displays a view from a high vantage point overlooking the city of New York. The brushstrokes are detailed and give a realistic look to the scene. The color scheme includes muted earth tones, with greens and browns in the foreground and blues and grays in the background. Clouds are visible in the sky, and sailboats are on the water. Two figures are also depicted on the grassy slope in the foreground.

artworks.title: New York from Weehawk
artworks.artist: John Hill. after William Guy Wall
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from an elevated vantage point, showing a serene expanse of water dominating the middle to distant sections. The horizon line is high, revealing a distant cityscape silhouette against the sky with buildings and chimneys. Sailing vessels and a steamship navigate the water. The landscape is rocky and wooded with a dirt path where a person on horseback and a pedestrian are visible, leading towards buildings among trees. The style is detailed with fine brushstrokes defining leaves and grass. The color palette includes muted tones like greens, browns, blues, and grays blending harmoniously.

artworks.title: A Triumphal Arch with Caparisoned Horses and Ornamented Pinnacles
artworks.medium: pen and black ink  with gray wash over traces of graphite on vellum
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure with arches, statues, and decorative horses. There are three barrel-vaulted arches with intricate moldings and statues of mythical figures. Above the arches is a cornice with three stylized spires adorned with relief carvings and medallions. At the top, there are three detailed statues of rearing horses above entrances. The drawing is rendered in precise linework, typical of neoclassical or Renaissance-inspired architectural studies.

artworks.title: Castor and Pollux Rescuing Helen
artworks.medium: pen and ink with wash over graphite, heightened with white gouache on toned paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ancient scene with a chariot and figures gesturing animatedly. The artwork is rendered in a monochrome palette with shades of brown, emphasizing the dramatic expressions and movements of the figures. Two central figures are depicted in classical attire, with one extending an arm in a gesture of guidance or command, while others around them hold long horns. The chariot is drawn by robust horses, contributing to the sense of movement and urgency in the scene. In the background are architectural elements suggestive of classical buildings and a landscape that recedes with a smoke or mist-like haze.

artworks.title: Aurora Heralding the Arrival of the Morning Sun
artworks.medium: brown and black chalk with stumping, heightened with white chalk on buff laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a cloudscape with divine light. The image is detailed with figures reclining and interacting within clouds, illuminated by a central burst of light. It is enclosed within an octagonal frame, enhancing the ethereal quality. The shading and line work create depth and motion, with a style reminiscent of Baroque art.

artworks.title: Trees and Meadows at Eragny
artworks.medium: black chalk on originally pale pink laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The drawing depicts an expansive landscape with softly rolling hills stretching into the distance. The horizon is high in the image, marked by a line of distant trees. Clusters of trees can be seen in the distance, beyond a cleared field. In the foreground, there are bare trees on the left and fuller foliage on the right, framing the center. The drawing uses subtle pencil strokes to suggest textures, with a monochromatic color palette of gray shades.

artworks.title: Pont des Arts, Paris
artworks.medium: gum dichromate print
artworks.description: The image shows the view from underneath a bridge, showcasing its structural framework against the sky. There are several barges on the river below, near another bridge in the distance. The water reflects the surroundings, creating a tranquil scene. The image has a textured, grainy appearance reminiscent of early photography, with a color palette dominated by sepia tones.

artworks.title: Peamore, Devon
artworks.medium: wash and watercolor with pen and black ink over graphite on eight joined sheets of laid paper, on the artist's original mount
artworks.description: The image shows a forest by a serene, tree-lined body of water. The horizon is high with tall trees extending close to it, creating a sense of depth. The brushstrokes and watercolor application are delicate, capturing textures of leaves and water gently. The color palette includes muted greens, soft browns, and hints of blue and cream. Closest to us is a dense cluster of trees on the right, curving over the water. Across the water, other tree clusters and shrubs recede into the misty background towards the left.

artworks.title: Lady in the Rain
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in black
artworks.description: The image contains bold, sweeping lines and forms creating an abstract depiction. The lines and shapes suggest figures resembling people gathered in a dynamic scene. Some elements evoke people with elongated limbs and flowing garments, hinting at interaction or conversation. Overlapping lines and filled areas convey depth and movement, inviting viewers to relate to social gatherings.

artworks.title: The Four Times of Day
artworks.medium: complete set of four etchings with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of four mythological scenes. The image is divided into four separate panels, each showing muscular, mythological figures in classical settings with props like urns, drapery, and rocky landscapes.

The top left panel shows two figures in a pastoral setting with an urn on the right and a rooster. The top right panel depicts figures under a canopy or natural formation.

The bottom left panel features a seated figure resting against a tree with a jug nearby, accompanied by a companion. The bottom right panel shows figures in repose beneath a glowing urn.

The panels share stylistic elements like detailed hatching and robust figures, creating a classical theme linking nature, time, and human form.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on the Crescent
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 11.5 x 7.2 cm (4 1/2 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Transfer from the National Gallery of Art Library
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing on a crescent holding a child. The woman has delicate features, long flowing hair, and wears flowing robes. The child is wrapped in fabric and held closely in her arms. The woman holds a scepter in one hand. The background has radiating lines creating a halo effect around her.

artworks.title: A Splendid Young Stag before a Wattle Fence
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a monochrome drawing of a woodland scene with a stag standing at the center. The viewpoint is at eye level with the stag, positioned right of center. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage and trees. The drawing style includes intricate pencil or ink strokes to depict the stag's fur and surrounding flora. A lattice-like structure made of branches is visible behind the stag. The color palette consists of shades of gray and beige. Trees frame the composition, with fine details like grass and stones included.

artworks.title: Hercules and the Nemean Lion
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter Fund and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a human figure wrestling with a lion. The drawing shows a muscular, nude human grappling with a lion. The human figure has their back to the viewer and appears to be exerting strength while facing the fierce lion, which is standing on its hind legs. The drawing features bold lines and detailed shading that emphasizes the musculature of both figures, showcasing the tension and interaction between the man and the beast. The composition conveys movement and conflict through the entwined positioning of the two figures.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman (Marguérite Adolphine Helfrich)
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of the upper half of a person's torso in profile, facing the right side. The individual has a long neck, delicate facial features, styled hair, a high-collared garment, and an elaborately decorated hat. The background is plain with the artist's signature and date.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 20.6 x 32 cm (8 1/8 x 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group observing a central figure being lifted from a sarcophagus. The scene is filled with detailed classical architecture surrounding a gathering of people in flowing robes. The figure emerging from the sarcophagus is positioned at the center. The architectural details include an arched ruin framing the gathering scene, and in the background, there are more ruins and classical structures underlined by a sky with clouds. To the right, a group of figures appears to be engaged in another scene. Vegetation grows at the forefront. There is an inscription in a rectangular panel in the top right-hand corner. The drawing showcases a high level of detail and composition typical of historical or mythological scenes.

artworks.title: C'est le Diable
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé
artworks.description: This is an image of a figure with wings. The figure is depicted with dark shading and contrasts, holding an object. The background is textured. There is a French caption at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Cup of Tea (La tasse de thé)
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a side profile of a person from the waist up, seated with a composed posture. The individual's face is turned sideways, featuring refined facial features with a soft expression, framed by dark, voluminous hair under a large, ornate hat with a plume. They wear a dark, formal garment with a high collar and have one hand resting on their lap while the other holds a small cup or vessel. In the background, there is a stack of framed artworks or large books against a surface. The scene has a chiaroscuro composition, with shadow creating depth.

artworks.title: The Marriage of the Virgin
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a historical scene within an architectural setting. The image features numerous figures on steps surrounded by grand columns, possibly engaged in various activities. The figures are clothed in flowing garments and show animated gestures and expressions. The composition leads the eye from the bottom to the top where a prominent figure stands between the columns under an arch, gesturing outward. The drawing showcases meticulous details in decor, attire, and structural elements, conveying a sense of grandeur and significance. The style is reminiscent of the High Renaissance, reflecting influences from artists like Raphael.
